newsitem.title: UK: Racal to buy BA pilot data publisher.
newsitem.headline: Racal to buy BA pilot data publisher.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc unit said on Friday that its Racal Avionics unit is to buy British Airways' Aerad flight navigation information business for "in the region of five million stg" in cash.

It said BA accounts for over half Aerad's current business, which employs 37 people and provides airlines as well as the Royal Air Force with navigational information such as en route charts and terminal approach procedures.
Under the terms of sale BA is to sign up to a long-term supply agreement for such services from Racal Avionics, which intends to combine Aerad with its own NavData Services division.
Racal said it expects the deal to be completed by June.
